Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.integrated

Class ChokeableGasLiftWell

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.integrated.ChokeableGasLiftWell
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ChokeableGasLiftWell extends Object implements Serializable
A gas-lifted producing well with a controllable choke and operational locks (NIP-2).

This descriptor couples a GasLiftPerformanceCurve (oil response to lift gas) with the operational degrees of freedom and constraints an operator actually works with when building a "strupe/øke" (choke-back / open-up) list:

  • Choke bound and setting - a maximum allowed choke opening fraction (e.g. 0.60 for a "0-60%" well) and the current opening.
  • Operational lock - a hard "keep shut" flag with a reason (sand production, lost communication, life extension, etc.).
  • Per-well gas-handling ceiling - a maximum produced-gas rate for the well (a "mye gass" limit).
  • Fluid ratios - water cut and gas/oil ratio, used to roll produced water and produced gas up to shared facility constraints.

The choke is modelled at screening level as a linear scale on deliverability: at the maximum allowed opening the well delivers the full GasLiftPerformanceCurve oil rate, and the rate scales linearly to zero as the opening closes. This keeps the "open the choke until a facility ceiling binds, then choke back the least efficient wells" logic of a strupe/øke list transparent. It is not a rigorous choke-pressure model.

1.0
Author:
NeqSim
